description: This file defines a utility class 'Log' that provides static methods for logging at various levels, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and facilitating log node chaining for custom logging implementations.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for logging, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage LogNode chaining.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current head of the LogNode chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
